title: MV Sprite Request based on My Concept Art - MV

posts.author: Dragonbrew
posts.body: I am returning to Rpg Maker after a long period, I upgraded to the MV from Ace. I am currently working on a non-commercial project to get back in the swing of things that may be my stepping stone to a commercial project. I need a sprite of my concept art for a game saver icon. Image is attached and if possible I would like a non bloom version that blooms open like the concept art, if that is possible. If not a stand alone sprite of the bloomed version would be fine. Thanks for any help.

posts.author: wingkowati
posts.body: Here is the Pixel Art version, even though the size is not really equal to standard MV tiles which is 48*48.
